notes: Ground truth for one physical desk, declared once so the kit compares mechanically instead of a person deciding the output looks about right. Copy this, describe your own hardware, and keep your copy out of git if the strings identify you.

devices.label: internal panel
devices.why: The case from issue #14: most laptops enumerate their own panel with a generic name, and the old heuristic read that as external.

devices.label: external monitor
devices.why: Must stay visible regardless of what its marketing name contains.

devices.label: dock
devices.why: An external unit that reports a serial should get exactly one unit key.

devices.label: USB4 retimer
devices.why: A negative assertion, and the one that would have caught the shipped bug: retimer instance ids end in location tokens, which are not serials. Three of these once shared a single key.
